subject: Staged upfront and net terms for multi-year commitment
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara.k@greenwave.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@gwave.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Inquiry: multi-year pricing and payment flexibility

Neha —

Thanks for taking this on. Greenwave is evaluating a three-year deployment of Redwood for our production inference workloads (starting Q3). A few priorities from procurement and finance that will drive our internal approval:

- Term discount levels for 2- vs 3-year prepay (we're sensitive to sticker + performance).
- Ability to do staged payments / milestone invoicing rather than a full 3-yr upfront charge.
- Payment terms: procurement prefers Net90 for enterprise commitments; finance has limited headroom for large immediate outlays.

Attached is a short RFP with our expected ramp (year 1: 30% of peak, year 2: 60%, year 3: 100%) and volume estimates. Can you share options (annual prepay, multi-year prepay with reduced discount if staged, and any risk mitigations Redwood would require for Net90)?

We'd like to schedule a 30-minute alignment call this week if possible.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Klein
Head of Platform Partnerships
Greenwave Analytics
Attachments: GW_RFP_Q2-2026.pdf (requirements, 120 KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Klein <sara.k@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: multi-year pricing and payment flexibility

Sara —

Appreciate the detail and the RFP. High-level options we can offer today (I put Aditya on CC for finance requirements):

1) Annual prepay (billed at the start of each contract year): 5% discount off list for each annual prepay. Lower operational overhead for you.

2) Full 3-year prepay (single upfront payment): 12% term discount off multi-year list, subject to standard SLA and data controls. This provides the best unit economics.

3) Staged prepay (hybrid): For customers who need to spread cash, we can do a staged schedule with a reduced term discount (typically ~8% for 3-year staged vs 12% full prepay). Common schedules are: 30% upfront / 40% at 12 months / 30% at 24 months, or a milestone-based schedule aligned to usage ramps.

Net terms: Our standard is Net30. For Net60/Net90 we require either: a) larger upfront (higher % prepaid) or b) a Letter of Credit/escrow arrangement, or c) contractually defined milestone invoices with acceptance triggers.

If you're open to a call, I can walk through a tailored proposal and draft a short term sheet. I've attached an options workbook that lays out price math for a 3-year ramp.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Attachments: Redwood_MultiYear_Options.xlsx (pricing workbook, 80 KB)

Neha/Sara —

Quick finance note from our side. Greenwave's corporate policy prefers Net90 for new platform commitments over $500k; cashflow is tight in H2. We can do a meaningful upfront payment but not the full 3-year prepay. Our proposal: 40% upfront, 30% at 12 months, 30% at 24 months. We'd like Net90 on the non-upfront milestone invoices.

We can also entertain a PO with payment triggers tied to delivery milestones if that makes Redwood more comfortable. If Redwood needs stronger assurance I can ask procurement about escrow or a bank guarantee — would prefer to avoid that if we can.

Tom
Tom Alvarez
CFO, Greenwave Analytics
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara.k@greenwave.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@gwave.ai>
Date: 2026-04-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: multi-year pricing and payment flexibility — finance perspective

Neha / team —

From Finance: Net30 is Redwood's baseline. For customers requesting Net60/Net90 we typically require one of the following:

- Increased upfront (>=30%) plus milestone invoices on Net60;
- A Letter of Credit or bank guarantee covering >70% of unbilled committed amount;
- An escrow arrangement for the full prepay amount if they want the full 3-year discount but pay Net90.

On discounts: the full 3-year prepay (lump sum) at signature gets us the 12% discount (as Neha noted). For staged schedules we can move to 8–9% depending on the exact split and the customer's credit. Given Tom's ask (40/30/30) we would be comfortable at an 8% term discount if the upfront is 40% and the remainder billed as milestone invoices on Net60. If Greenwave insists on Net90 for the milestone invoices, Finance would prefer a 50% upfront or a bank guarantee.

Connor — from an implementation standpoint, can you confirm the acceptance triggers that would make milestone billing practical?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara.k@greenwave.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@gwave.ai>
Date: 2026-04-21T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: multi-year pricing and payment flexibility — implementation note

Aditya / Neha / Greenwave —

Implementation acceptance milestones that align with our rollout and are easy to invoice against:

- Milestone A (Upfront): Signature + environment provisioning complete (initial capacity reserved).
- Milestone B (12 months): Production cutover for up to agreed baseline capacity (we typically define as X tokens/day or configured endpoints).
- Milestone C (24 months): Full ramp to agreed peak capacity or delivery of integration points (webhooks, monitoring hooks).

We can include short test checkpoints and a 10-business-day window for acceptance before billing. That will let procurement sign off on milestone invoices.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Staged upfront and net terms for multi-year commitment — proposed term sheet

Tom/Sara —

Thanks for the clarity. Based on internal alignment, here's the proposal I'm sending for legal review and signature (attached as Proposal_GW-Redwood_MultiYear_v2.pdf):

- Term: 36 months (starts on signature)
- Pricing: list rate with an 8% multi-year term discount (staged schedule).
- Payment schedule (staged prepay): 30% due at signature (Invoice 001), 30% due at 12 months (Invoice 002), 20% due at 24 months (Invoice 003), 20% due at 30 months (Invoice 004).
- Net terms: Invoice 001 (upfront) payable Net30; milestone invoices (002–004) payable Net60. If Greenwave requires Net90 on milestone invoices, Redwood requests either a 50% upfront payment or a bank guarantee covering the unbilled balance.
- Acceptance triggers per Connor's notes (provisioning, production cutover, full ramp). 10-business-day acceptance window for milestone invoices.
- SLAs and service credits: standard Redwood SLA, plus a 10% credit on the monthly invoice for downtime > 4 hours/month (to be approved in the contract).

Next steps: I've attached the updated proposal and included a DocuSign link for signature. Please review; if this looks acceptable we can route to legal and procurement. If you prefer different invoice splits we can iterate — the discount is sensitive to the upfront amount.
